title: Pantry
subtitle: What you have at home, the pack sizes you buy, and the products of Swiss shops.

stock.help: Only stock marked "confirmed usable" is deducted from your shopping. Unconfirmed or expired stock is never counted.
stock.empty: Your stock is empty. Add what you have at home, or put your purchases away from a shopping plan.
stock.no-match: No food in stock matches this search.
stock.confirmed-help: Turn it on once you have checked that the food is there and still good. Otherwise it is not deducted from the shopping.

packagings.help: A pack size is the size of the pack you buy. In a shopping plan, the quantity to buy is rounded up to a whole number of packs. Only the default pack size of a food is used for rounding.
packagings.empty: No pack size yet. Without one, the quantities to buy are not rounded.
packagings.quantity-invalid: The quantity must be greater than zero.
packagings.label: Label
packagings.default-help: The default pack size rounds the shopping for this food.

products.help: Search a product sold in Switzerland to learn its pack size and what its label says.
products.source: The data comes from Open Food Facts, an open product database (ODbL licence).
products.privacy: Only the search text or the barcode of the product is sent to this database, never anything about a person.
products.unavailable: The product database does not answer — the rest of the application works without it.
products.link-title: Link the product to a food
products.create-packaging-help: The size of the pack becomes the default pack size of the food.

hint.LABEL_CLAIM: Announced free from {key} — check it on the pack
hint.NO_PACK_SIZE: Pack size unknown: no pack size created

products.hint-warning: A label is a hint, never a verification. Read the pack of the product you buy, then confirm it yourself.
products.delete-confirm: Delete the product "{name}"? The pack sizes and the stock that come from it are kept.
